info.title: Aroma Launcher
info.author: PretenZeo
info.description: A legacy HBL-style frontend for Aroma.
info.details:
Aroma Launcher is an HBL-styled frontend build for the Aroma Environment. It supports launching WUHB and RPX applications, browsing legacy (but not launching) ELF files, put into the style and functionality of the legacy HBL. 

THIS IS NOT A REPLACEMENT FOR AROMA APPLICATIONS! 

This is designed to bring the look and feel of the classic HBL into the Aroma Environment.
